tables.name: Settings
tables.description: Configuration values for all clinically-governed parameters. Clinical sign-off populates the Approved Value column. NEVER hardcode these thresholds in formulas - read them from here so sign-off does not require a rebuild.

tables.name: Patients
tables.description: Master patient table. Mirrors the existing Unite-fed patient list; keep Patient ID aligned with Unite PIN.

tables.name: Medication Reference
tables.description: PHASE 1 - BUILD FIRST. Master drug classification keyed on Unite localcode. Nothing in the medication sequence works without this. Classify by CODE not name: 'Doxycycline 100 mg Tablet' string matching breaks across dosage variants. Unknown codes must FAIL CLOSED - no sequence fires.

tables.name: Visits
tables.description: Landing table for the Unite daily feed. CRITICAL: Unite sends BP as a single string e.g. '92/61' - it MUST be parsed into BP Systolic and BP Diastolic numeric fields at ingest or every adult and gynaecology vitals rule fails silently.

fields.name: Age at Visit
fields.description: Age in years AT THE VISIT, not today. The infant fever rule (temp >= 38.0 AND age < 2) depends on this being age at visit.

fields.name: Vitals Complete
fields.description: Data quality flag. Feeds the Data Quality Exceptions view. Missing vitals must never be read as normal vitals.

fields.name: TRIGGER Paediatrics
fields.description: PAED-01 to PAED-09. Gated on Department Effective, NOT the raw Department field - Unite reports department at patient level so children arrive tagged GP. Rule 2 is the infant fever rule: temp >= 38.0 AND age < 2 - do not simplify. SEIZURE IS DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED (clinically rejected - needs a real clinical pathway, not an automated message). All numeric tests guard against BLANK because a blank numeric evaluates as 0 in Airtable. Free-text tests read Observation Notes, which is negation-scrubbed at ingest by the Make sync.
fields.formula:
IF({fldWrg409vbzA9Sp7} != "Paediatrics", "", TRIM(
 IF(AND({fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} != BLANK(), {fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} >= 39), "PAED-01 ", "") &
 IF(AND({fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} != BLANK(), {fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} >= 38, {fldTQMLFKlaMkjFm0} != BLANK(), {fldTQMLFKlaMkjFm0} < 2), "PAED-02-INFANT ", "") &
 IF(AND(OR(FIND("fever", LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD})) > 0, FIND("fever", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0), OR(FIND("unwell", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0, FIND("lethargic", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0)), "PAED-03 ", "") &
 IF(AND({fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} != BLANK(), {fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} <= 94), "PAED-04 ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "shortness of breath|wheeze|bronchiolitis|pneumonia|croup|respiratory distress"), "PAED-05 ", "") &
 IF(AND(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "vomit|diarrh"), REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "poor intake|dehydrat|dry mouth|reduced urine|lethargic")), "PAED-06 ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD}), "uti|pyelonephritis|tonsillitis|otitis media|pneumonia|cellulitis"), "PAED-07 ", "") &
 IF(AND({fldni7004CwZHjnl1} != BLANK(), {fldni7004CwZHjnl1} > 0), "PAED-08 ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fldutfsNvr26p8pLy}), "er advised|ed advised|return if worse|follow up advised|follow-up advised"), "PAED-09 ", "")
))

fields.name: TRIGGER GP
fields.description: GP-01 to GP-06. Gated on Department Effective so under-14s are excluded from GP rules and handled paediatrically. GP-05 (new medication risk) is LIVE via the Has Antibiotic / Has Steroid rollups; fails closed on unclassified drugs. GP-04-PROC uses LEN(TRIM()) > 0 because an empty multilineText field in Airtable is an empty string, not blank. GP-02-REDFLAG reads free-text narrative and fired a false positive on the first live run against notes containing denials - Observation Notes is now negation-scrubbed at ingest by the Make sync, and this rule remains the one to watch during internal validation.
fields.formula:
IF({fldWrg409vbzA9Sp7} != "GP", "", TRIM(
 IF(OR(AND({fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} != BLANK(), {fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} >= 39), AND({fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} != BLANK(), {fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} < 90), AND({fld0uMrH7Uu9lCxdv} != BLANK(), {fld0uMrH7Uu9lCxdv} < 60), AND({fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} != BLANK(), {fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} <= 94), AND({fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} != BLANK(), {fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} >= 110)), "GP-01-VITALS ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "chest pain|shortness of breath|syncope|fainting|palpitations|severe abdominal pain|persistent vomiting|blood in stool|severe headache|neurological deficit|confusion"), "GP-02-REDFLAG ", "") &
 IF(AND(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD}), "infect|pneumonia|uti|cellulitis|abscess|infected wound"), {fldni7004CwZHjnl1} != BLANK(), {fldni7004CwZHjnl1} > 0), "GP-03 ", "") &
 IF(LEN(TRIM({fldyu2FVfEijTqWUR})) > 0, "GP-04-PROC ", "") &
 IF(OR({fldnkbivqcfkreotL} = 1, {fldx7MZfenSV5s4ak} = 1), "GP-05-MEDS ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fldutfsNvr26p8pLy}), "follow up advised|follow-up advised|review in|return tomorrow"), "GP-06 ", "")
))

fields.name: TRIGGER Gynaecology
fields.description: GYN-01 to GYN-09. Gated on Department Effective so under-14s are excluded and handled paediatrically. TWO CLINICAL EXCLUSIONS ARE DELIBERATE. (1) Abnormal imaging and structural findings do NOT trigger - no TVUS findings, endometrial thickness or ovarian morphology - because 'the diagnosis is not static, it varies from person to person and so does the treatment'. (2) Pap smear triggers ONLY when Pap Result = Positive. GYN-05: adenomyosis, fibroid and endometriosis are STRUCTURAL diagnoses and do not trigger alone - a pain or symptom term must also be present. Without this the imaging exclusion was silently defeated. GYN-07 uses LEN(TRIM()) > 0.
fields.formula:
IF({fldWrg409vbzA9Sp7} != "Gynaecology", "", TRIM(
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fldXAkFSh3q9dlkEC}), "abnormal uterine bleeding|aub|postcoital|intermenstrual|menorrhagia"), "GYN-01-BLEED ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "contact bleeding|active bleeding"), "GYN-02-BLEED ", "") &
 IF(AND(FIND("spotting", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0, REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "pain|fatigue")), "GYN-03 ", "") &
 IF(OR(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "green discharge|yellow discharge|foul"), REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fldWNmWnvGBPYwZ6P}), "hvs|vaginal swab|culture"), REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD}), "vaginitis|cervicitis|pid|pelvic inflammatory")), "GYN-04-INFECT ", "") &
 IF(OR(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "pelvic pain|perineal pain|dysmenorrh"), AND(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "adenomyosis|fibroid|endometriosis"), REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "pain|bleed|heavy|discomfort"))), "GYN-05-PAIN ", "") &
 IF(OR(AND({fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} != BLANK(), {fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} < 95, {fld2al0GgsV6g4Rdi}), AND({fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} != BLANK(), {fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} >= 100, REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fld5WrzkmTaFitlca}), "pain|bleed")), AND(FIND("fatigue", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0, FIND("bleed", LOWER({fld5WrzkmTaFitlca})) > 0)), "GYN-06-VITALS ", "") &
 IF(AND(LEN(TRIM({fldyu2FVfEijTqWUR})) > 0, REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fldyu2FVfEijTqWUR}), "biopsy|cervical examination")), "GYN-07-PROC ", "") &
 IF(AND(FIND("pap", LOWER({fldyu2FVfEijTqWUR})) > 0, {fldgZRyGr1tVmNbYk} = "Positive"), "GYN-08-PAP ", "") &
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({fldutfsNvr26p8pLy}), "follow up advised|review after results|monitor symptoms"), "GYN-09 ", "")
))

fields.name: Trigger Rules Fired
fields.description: Concatenation of all rule IDs that matched, across departments. Needed for clinical validation and audit: the clinical lead must be able to see WHY a follow-up was raised.

fields.name: Trigger Category
fields.description: Drives which call script is used and the default follow-up interval. Reads Department Effective so paediatric cases are recognised even when Unite tags the patient as GP. FIXED ON FIRST LIVE RUN: the Bleeding test previously read Observation Notes and matched narrative containing denials ('denies blood in stool'), sending two of three real GP visits to the Bleeding script. Bleeding is now driven by the CODED diagnosis fields only - Primary Diagnosis Text and Secondary Diagnosis Codes - never by narrative. Post-Procedure uses LEN(TRIM()) > 0 - an empty multilineText field is an empty string, not blank. Priority order: Paediatrics is evaluated first because paediatric cases carry the highest parental anxiety and clinical risk. Confirm the remaining order with the clinical lead.
fields.formula:
IF({fld2MgtyrFuHEgHIz} = "", "",
 IF({fldWrg409vbzA9Sp7} = "Paediatrics", "Paediatric High-Concern",
 IF(REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD} & " " & {fldXAkFSh3q9dlkEC}), "bleed|menorrhagia|spotting|haemorrhage|hemorrhage"), "Bleeding",
 IF(OR(AND({fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} != BLANK(), {fldW2drDyJO7x4Bhn} >= 39), AND({fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} != BLANK(), {fldfGYvo9oW5pFvMY} <= 94), AND({fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} != BLANK(), {fld4MabuolV2ia0hn} < 95), AND({fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} != BLANK(), {fldzTCJ2RDTiyZV6p} >= 100)), "Vitals",
 IF(AND({fldni7004CwZHjnl1} != BLANK(), {fldni7004CwZHjnl1} > 0, REGEX_MATCH(LOWER({flduu0Nv3L4JCMitD}), "infect|pneumonia|uti|cellulitis|abscess|vaginitis|cervicitis|pid")), "Infection-Labs",
 IF(LEN(TRIM({fldyu2FVfEijTqWUR})) > 0, "Post-Procedure",
 "Clinical Check"))))))

fields.name: Follow-Up Due Date
fields.description: Graduated timing per the specification - do NOT flatten to a single interval. WORKAROUND IN PLACE: WORKDAY() is used so a Friday visit rolls forward rather than landing on a non-working day. Confirm the clinic operating week with Abdul, then adjust the holidays argument. STILL TO ADD: parse 'review in X days' from Plan of Treatment and use X in preference to the category default.
fields.formula:
IF({fld0Dk59ehaDtIv8b} = "", BLANK(),
 IF(OR({fld0Dk59ehaDtIv8b} = "Paediatric High-Concern", {fld0Dk59ehaDtIv8b} = "Vitals", {fld0Dk59ehaDtIv8b} = "Bleeding", {fld0Dk59ehaDtIv8b} = "Infection-Labs"),
  WORKDAY({fldXlyyw4yhhwby2g}, 1),
  WORKDAY({fldXlyyw4yhhwby2g}, 2)))

fields.name: Dedupe Key
fields.description: Prevents duplicate Follow-Up Queue records and duplicate sends when Unite re-syncs the same visit. Automations must check this key before creating a queue record.

fields.name: Has Antibiotic
fields.description: Rollup over Prescriptions link taking MAX(Is Antibiotic). 1 = at least one antibiotic prescribed at this visit. Enables GP-05 medication compliance rule. Fails closed: unclassified drugs return 0.

fields.name: Has Steroid
fields.description: Rollup over Prescriptions link taking MAX(Is Steroid). 1 = at least one steroid prescribed at this visit. Feeds GP-05 medication compliance rule.

fields.name: Department Effective
fields.description: SAFETY OVERRIDE + DOCTOR ROUTING. All three TRIGGER formulas and the Trigger Category cascade read THIS field, never the raw Department field, because Unite supplies Department at PATIENT level, not visit level. Two corrections are applied in priority order. (1) Anyone under 14 at the visit is forced to Paediatrics regardless of what Unite says - a 3-year-old was classified GP on the first live run and never reached the paediatric rules. (2) Doctor-based routing: paste each doctor's name into the matching list below and every existing visit re-evaluates immediately, no re-sync needed. Names must match the Doctor field exactly as Unite sends it; separate multiple names with a pipe. THE LISTS ARE CURRENTLY EMPTY, so behaviour falls through to the raw Unite department until someone fills them in. KNOWN GAP: a 41-year-old with irregular menstruation, pelvic pain and a TVUS is currently classified GP and the gynaecology rules never run on her. Filling the Gynaecology list fixes that case and every one like it. (Audit note: the list of 16 doctor names in the original description is kept out of this snapshot; it is staff data available in the live base.)
fields.formula:
IF(
  AND({fldTQMLFKlaMkjFm0} != BLANK(), {fldTQMLFKlaMkjFm0} < 14),
  "Paediatrics",
  IF(
    AND(LEN(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})) > 0, FIND(LOWER(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})), LOWER("")) > 0),
    "Gynaecology",
    IF(
      AND(LEN(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})) > 0, FIND(LOWER(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})), LOWER("")) > 0),
      "Paediatrics",
      IF(
        AND(LEN(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})) > 0, FIND(LOWER(TRIM({fld56HJ56HDz5ICqX})), LOWER("")) > 0),
        "GP",
        {fldfDoqBTP05oHIhJ} & ""
      )
    )
  )
)

tables.name: Prescriptions
tables.description: Medication sequence engine. Unite payload maps as: localcode to Medication Code, name to Medication Name, dosagedays to Duration (Days), totalquantity to Total Quantity, roadescription to Dosage Instruction.

fields.name: End Date
fields.description: Minus 1 day so that a 7-day course ending is day 7, not day 8.

fields.name: Is Antibiotic
fields.description: FAILS CLOSED. Only returns 1 on an explicit Antibiotic classification. UNCLASSIFIED or blank returns 0 so no sequence fires - a misclassification here would send a probiotic message to someone never on antibiotics.

fields.name: Day 3 Check Date
fields.description: Start + 2 gives day three inclusive of the start day. AWAITING CLINICAL CONFIRMATION whether day 3 means the third day of the course (start+2) or 72 hours after the first dose (start+3). Change the offset here only - it is referenced nowhere else.

fields.name: Probiotic Start Date
fields.description: Antibiotic End Date + 1 day. NOTE: this is the SCHEDULED date only. The automation must NOT send PROBIOTIC_START on this date alone - it must first check that Sequence Status is not HALTED - clinical. A patient who reported badly at day 3 must be routed to an appointment, not handed probiotics.

fields.name: Probiotic End Date
fields.description: Drives TREATMENT_OUTCOME, the only point in the whole programme where treatment outcome data is captured. Default probiotic duration of 10 days is AWAITING CLINICAL SIGN-OFF - see Settings table.

fields.name: Is Steroid
fields.description: FAILS CLOSED. Only returns 1 on an explicit Steroid classification. UNCLASSIFIED or blank returns 0. Mirrors Is Antibiotic.

tables.name: Follow-Up Queue
tables.description: Operational work queue. One record per triggered follow-up. Dedupe Key prevents duplicate entries when Unite re-syncs the same visit. PHASE 2 launches with internal nurse and call-centre tasks ONLY - no patient-facing messages until validation is signed off.

tables.name: Feedback & Outcomes
tables.description: The ONLY place treatment outcome data is captured. Red flag fires on score at or below threshold OR any side-effect keyword. Dual notification is mandatory: treating doctor for clinical judgement, care coordinator to close the loop.

fields.name: Needs Doctor Review
fields.description: RED FLAG. Fires on score at or below threshold OR any side-effect keyword. Note that a side effect fires the flag EVEN IF the score is high - a reply of 8 but I have a rash must escalate. Threshold of 5 is a Bilal-era value AWAITING CLINICAL SIGN-OFF. Dual notification is mandatory: treating doctor AND care coordinator.

tables.name: Message Templates
tables.description: Template register. All templates require clinical approval before creation in Sanoflow. Approved copy is carried from the original January specification.

tables.name: Message Log
tables.description: Audit log of every clinical send. Idempotency Key blocks duplicate sends when Unite re-syncs. Raw reply text is stored verbatim regardless of whether a score could be parsed.

tables.name: Test Plan
tables.description: Boundary test cases from the build specification. Test with synthetic records only - never live patients. Boundary cases matter more than volume.
